title: Implement branch-aware automatic task selection
description: Make flat-file readiness context-aware. On a named branch, task ready and task next may select only current-token scoped tasks plus legacy wtp-NNNN tasks; current-branch tasks form the first tier and legacy tasks the second. Foreign scoped tasks are excluded. In detached/non-Git contexts only legacy tasks are automatically eligible. Within each tier preserve assignee safety and preference (matching assignee before unassigned; never another assignee), paused before todo, higher priority, older createdAt, then shortId. Apply the same rules to PeekNextTask, PeekNextTasks, GetNextTask, and TaskReadiness.Claimable. Keep dependency blocking and locking atomic. Add provider tests proving branch tier dominates assignment/status/priority across tiers and existing order remains intact within a tier.
